Dark navy reflection environment ONLY in the materials; actual fully transparent background with alpha, no opaque rectangle, no floor or pedestal, no cast shadow outside the sculpture. The digits fill about 75 percent of the composition width. Studio rim lighting, balanced restrained details. Text: only "404", exactly once. Avoid extra writing, letters, logos, buttons, UI mockups, humans, astronauts, watermarks, checkerboard painted as background. This is a final project asset.
